note: Member-owned non-profit park, founded for Airstream rallies and open to the public. RV-only: no tents or pop-ups, and campers without full hookups aren't allowed. Mostly level grass sites. Mountain views between Caesars Head and Table Rock; private river frontage and walking trails. --Claude
summary: Operator site confirms $35 (tax included) full-hookup 30/50A at all 146 sites, no bathhouses, free Wi-Fi, online booking. Season now April 1-October 31 (was year_round false only; the note's 'Apr-mid-Nov' was wrong); added $3 booking fee, booking URL and policies. Note trimmed of hookups/counts/season.
